title: A New Korean Text Classification Benchmark for Recognizing the Political Intents in Online Newspapers

bias_targets.methodology: The authors created a multi-task dataset of 12,000 Korean news articles annotated for political orientation (liberal vs. conservative on a 5-point scale) and pro-government stance (criticism vs. advocacy on a 6-point scale). They evaluate the ability of transformer-based language models (such as KoBERT, KoBigBird, and KoELECTRA) to automatically classify these political biases and intents.
